capabilities: Loads local *plugin.js / *plugin.mjs modules from a vault folder
Hot-reloads modules with ESM cache busting
Cleans up module lifecycle with LIFO dispose
Switches settings, commands and notices between English and Chinese
disambiguation: Not a manager for published community plugins; it only loads local JavaScript modules from a configured vault folder.
extras: Desktop only; needs Obsidian 1.11.5+ for built-in SecretStorage. Modules run with full plugin privileges and no sandbox, so only trusted or self-written code should be placed in the modules folder. Chinese documentation available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run plain local JavaScript modules from the vault without packaging them as full plugins with a build step.
summary: Microkernel host that loads and hot-reloads local JavaScript drawer modules straight from a vault folder, with service registry, cleanup and secret storage.
